title: rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. arvensis
intro: Rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. arvensis, commonly known as the yellow rattle, is a parasitic plant that belongs to the Orobanchaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhinanthus alectorolophus subsp. arvensis include acting as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
